When lords and merchants speak of supply lines, they think first of war chests, supply lines, and alliances. Entry Supply Lines When orders are passed from the hall to the cottage, they always pass through human choice and local custom. Victory or defeat on the battlefield is important, but who can keep the army with horse supplies and silver coins in the second month often determines the length of the war.

Entry Supply Lines Entry Supply Lines When orders are passed from the hall to the cottage, they always pass through human choice and local custom. They look at whether the flag is at the front, whether the order is clear, and whether the wounded are recovered; a beautiful strategy is not worth singing if it does not allow people to return to the camp alive.

Entry Supply Lines Entry Supply Lines When orders are passed from the hall to the cottage, they always pass through human choice and local custom. Blacksmiths re-heat broken swords red, priests keep vigil for the dead; the war continues long after it has left the battlefield, on anvils, in graveyards, and on empty seats.

Entry Supply Lines Entry Supply Lines When orders are passed from the hall to the cottage, they always pass through human choice and local custom. The expedition took away horses, grain, and sons. The flags were changed several times, but they still had to repair houses, bury people, and wait for the next winter; they judged victory or defeat only by whether the village was still there.
